title: Measuring Human Adaptation to AI in Decision Making: Application to Evaluate Changes after AlphaGo
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a measure called the 'Human-AI Gap' to quantify human adaptation to AI in the context of decision-making in the game of Go.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a topic of the research. The study focuses on how human professional Go players adapt their decision-making after the introduction of superhuman AI like AlphaGo.
